BUILD 95
- The Floating Market is busier: a boat seller (dinghy, military dinghy, speedboat, left at a new slip off its east side), a Boat Mechanic selling low and regular quality pistons, spark plugs and carburetors with fuel, a wrench and metal fragments, an awning over the two, fish drying on a line, nets, crates and more barrels.
- The Fishing Port no longer has a recycler standing in the water where boats are tied up.
